meta.description: Upload a dental panoramic X-ray and see what the AI marks.
home.title: Read your dental panoramic X-ray
disclaimer.short: DentaVision AI results are not a medical diagnosis. Consult a dentist.
scan.title: Upload a panoramic X-ray
scan.lede: JPG or PNG up to 10 MB, compressed on your device before upload.
drop.unsupported_type: This file is not a JPG or PNG. Choose an X-ray image in JPG or PNG format.
drop.too_large: This file is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller image.
drop.unreadable: This image cannot be opened. Try another file.
progress.waking: Starting the server, usually under 1 minute
rejected.title: This image does not look like a dental panoramic X-ray
rejected.hint: Use a panoramic X-ray that shows both the upper and lower jaw.
error.busy: The server is processing another scan. Try again in a minute.
error.loading: The model is still loading on the server. Try again in a minute.
error.unavailable: The analysis server is not responding. Try again shortly.
error.too_large: The image is too large after compression. Try another image.
error.unsupported_type: The server cannot read this image. Try another JPG or PNG file.
error.storage: The result cannot be kept in this tab. Close other tabs or try another browser.
result.title: Scan result
result.low_quality: Low image resolution, findings may be missed.
result.empty: No scan result in this tab yet.
findings.title: Findings
findings.limits: The model often misses findings, so this does not replace a dental exam.
findings.empty: The AI marked nothing above this threshold.
viewer.label: Panoramic X-ray with finding boxes. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, H toggles the heatmap.
heatmap.label: Heatmap
heatmap.how: Bright areas are the parts of the image that most influenced the AI when it marked {name}. The heatmap shows where the model looked, not the exact edge of a condition.
sample.title: Try a sample
tabs.label: Result
insight.loading: The AI is writing a summary
insight.unavailable: The AI summary is not available right now. The detection results still work.
insight.source: Written by Gemini from the findings list, without seeing the image.
chat.suggest.attention: The AI marked {name}. What does that mean?
chat.suggest.treatment: What is the {name} on my X-ray?
chat.suggest.xray: What does a panoramic X-ray show?
chat.suggest.brushing: How do I brush my teeth properly?
chat.suggest.checkup: How often should I see a dentist?
chat.label: Conversation
chat.unavailable: AI chat is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
chat.interrupted: The answer stopped before it finished.
chat.source: Answers from Gemini based on the findings list, without seeing the image.
chat.title: Ask about dental health
chat.lede: Short AI answers to questions about teeth, gums, and mouth.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.lede: Sign in to keep scan results and chats in your history.
auth.register.title: Create account
auth.register.lede: Scan results and chats stay private to your account, and you can delete them at any time.
auth.reset.title: Reset password
auth.reset.lede: Ask for a link by email, then set a new password here.
auth.to_login: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.sent.verify: We sent a verification link to your email. Open it in this browser to activate your account.
auth.sent.reset: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Open it in this browser.
auth.updated: Password updated. You are signed in.
auth.error.email_not_confirmed: Your email is not verified yet. Open the link in your sign-up email.
auth.error.weak_password: That password is too weak. Use a longer one that is hard to guess.
auth.error.same_password: The new password must differ from the old one.
auth.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.error.link_expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.error.google_unavailable: Google sign-in is unavailable right now. Use email and password.
auth.error.generic: We could not process that request. Try again shortly.
history.title: History
history.delete_scan_confirm: Delete this scan? The image and related conversation will be permanently deleted from the server.
history.delete_chat_confirm: Delete this conversation? The conversation will be permanently deleted from the server.
history.delete_error: Failed to delete. Try again shortly.
